claimsToVerify: Egyptian scribal students commonly practiced writing on pottery shards and limestone flakes (ostraca).
During the annual Nile inundation (Akhet), farmers were often mobilized for state labor projects (corvée).
The Middle Kingdom text 'The Satire of the Trades' specifically contrasts the harsh life of farmers and artisans with the privileged status of scribes.
